minutes.headline: Select Board goals workshop reworded and trimmed draft goals; no stand-alone budget goal was kept.
minutes.summary: The Select Board held a goals workshop in place of its regular agenda, with no public comment. Members and the town manager discussed tying goal setting to the fiscal year, then edited the compiled draft goals line by line. Staffing, goal setting, transparency and a staff-planning goal were reworded and kept. A recognition objective, budget goal and municipal buildings goal were debated and set aside or folded elsewhere. The meeting adjourned by voice vote.

budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager gave new voting equipment as an example of a goal that must be funded in the budget.
A member described peer-nominated recognition programs elsewhere with a small gift certificate prize.
The town manager described another town's awards program and said pizza for a training is a small cost.
A member said staff events would need a budget but are not thousands of dollars.
A member said the override came from the school committee's late budget, not the town side.

decisions.decision: Board agreed not to rank the goals by priority.
Goal on revamping the goal-setting process settled with edits to objectives two and four.
Added an objective on identifying technology resources critical to staff and their maintenance schedule.
Chair kept the recognition objective despite a majority leaning to remove it; wording to change toward a program.
Added an objective to ensure all public meetings are recorded.
Draft was cut to a shorter set of goals, with the staff-planning goal likely multi-year.

what_happened.line: The Select Board held a goals workshop instead of its regular agenda and edited the compiled draft goals line by line; no votes were taken.
The board agreed not to rank the goals by priority.
The recognition objective was kept by the chair despite a majority leaning to remove it, with wording to shift toward a program.
The stand-alone budget goal was set aside, and the draft was cut to a shorter set, with the staff-planning goal likely to run multi-year.
Objectives were added to identify critical technology resources for staff and to ensure all public meetings are recorded.

why_it_matters: These goals frame what the Select Board and town manager will ask to fund in coming budgets, and dropping a stand-alone budget goal means budget work is not a named priority of its own.
The staff-planning goal, technology list and recording of all public meetings touch town services and how easily residents can follow decisions.
